A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Expert Race/Race-DiT work. All 23 pages, including equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–E, are available and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original ImageNet generation experiments, routing and component ablations, scaling results, and an additional DiT-MoE comparison in Appendix D.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and quantitative results, alongside generated-image examples in the main text and Appendix E.

M1.justification: Global top-K routing, the EMA inference threshold, router similarity loss and per-layer regularization remain unchanged. Algorithm 1's implementation corrections align its pseudocode with the method already specified in v1; they do not establish a different proposed procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same ImageNet image-generation coverage and experimental scenarios. Replacing individual gallery examples does not establish additional datasets, tasks or test conditions.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged across the corresponding experiments, including Token Choice, Expert Choice, extended routing variants, dense DiT, the Table 7 generative baselines and Appendix D's DiT-MoE comparison.

E3.justification: Previously stated training budgets, model configurations and metrics remain unchanged. Section 7.8 newly specifies evaluation guidance 1.5; this is a disclosure, not evidence of a changed protocol. Image guidance 4.0 was already stated in v1's captions.

E4.justification: The routing, gating, load-balancing, component and scaling analyses in Sections 7.2–7.7 remain unchanged. Gallery substitutions introduce no new diagnostic analysis, ablation or robustness test.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged throughout the experiments and appendices. Neither version reports repeated-run counts, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: Figure 11 replaces some generated examples, including a basket with a snail, and Appendix E's Figure 19 replaces several convertible samples. Numerical results and training curves remain unchanged, including RaceDiT's Table 7 FID of 2.06.

T1.justification: Equations 1–15, the routing optimization formulation, Appendix B's router-similarity-loss derivation and Appendix C's combination-usage definition are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims concerning routing flexibility, efficient scaling, expert diversity and shallow-layer learning.

C2.justification: Interpretations of spatial and temporal allocation, expert collapse, shallow-layer learning and training–inference mismatch are unchanged. No substantive limitations or applicability qualifications are added or removed.

D1.justification: Algorithm 1 corrects K-th-largest selection, extraction of the threshold value, mask reshaping and output broadcasting. Section 7.8 newly discloses classifier-free guidance 1.5 for evaluation and repeats the already documented image-generation guidance of 4.0.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the 46 references are unchanged, as is the positioning relative to earlier routing strategies and diffusion MoE models.

P1.justification: v3 adds an acknowledgement and a short guidance-setting sentence, and updates the front-matter dates/version information. The section order, narrative and appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 11 and 19 substitute sample images within their existing layouts. Table 2 newly bolds the unchanged MaxVio value 0.850, and there are small front-page and spacing adjustments.

improvement.justification: Correcting Algorithm 1's selection and tensor-shape errors and disclosing evaluation guidance improve reproducibility. These are useful, limited repairs: quantitative evidence, theoretical support and core claims remain unchanged, while the substituted gallery images do not establish improved performance.
